title: Isolation of exosomal RNA from urine using the Qiagen ExoRNeasy maxi kit
protocol: Thaw samples on ice.
Transfer 0.5 mL of urine into a 1.5 mL microfuge tube.
Add 0.5 mL XBP to the tube.
Invert the tube 5 times.
Add the sample/XBP mixture onto the exoEasy spin column in a 15 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 500 x g at room temperature.
Discard flow-through from the centrifugation step.
Add 3.5 mL XWP to the exoEasy spin column.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000 x g at room temperature.
Transfer the spin column to a fresh collection tube.
Add 700 µL Qiazol to the membrane of the spin column.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000 x g at room temperature.
Transfer the flow-through, which is the lysate, to a PLG tube.
Vortex the mixture for 5 s.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5 min.
Add 90 µL chloroform to the mixture.
Shake vigorously for 15 s.
Incubate the sample for 3 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge the sample for 15 min at 12,000 x g at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase (270 µL) to a new microcentrifuge tube after centrifugation.
Carefully measure the aqueous phase and add 2 volumes (540 µL) of 100% ethanol.
Mix gently and thoroughly without centrifuging.
Assemble a MinElute spin column in a new collection tube.
Load up to 700 µL of the mixture from step, including any precipitate that may have formed, onto the column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at 1,000 x g at room temperature.
Discard flow-through.
Repeat steps until entire sample has been loaded.
Add 700 μL Buffer RWT to the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at ≥ 8000 x g at room temperature to wash the column.
Discard the flow-through.
Pipette 500 μL Buffer RPE onto the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at ≥ 8000 x g to wash the column.
Discard the flow-through.
Pipette 500 μL Buffer RPE onto the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 2 min at ≥ 8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm) at room temperature to wash the column.
Discard the collection tube with the flow-through.
Transfer the RNeasy MinElute spin column into a new 2 mL collection tube (supplied).
Open the lid of the spin column and centrifuge at full speed (14,000 x g) for 5 min to dry the membrane.
Discard the collection tube with the flow-through.
Transfer the RNeasy MinElute spin column to a new 1.5 mL collection tube (supplied).
Add 14 μL RNase-free water directly to the center of the spin column membrane.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 100 x g.
Centrifuge at full speed for 1 min to elute the RNA.
